content.short: AngelBlock Protocol is a non-custodial fundraising platform addressing funding hurdles for Web3 startups.
content.description: AngelBlock Protocol aims to establish a widely adopted standard for a Web3-native fundraising process. Current Web3 fundraise practices continue to rely on traditional Web2 methods, offering limited protections for startups and investors. Startups risk investors prioritizing their own interests and exiting prematurely, while investors face risks from rug pulls and projects failing to meet promised milestones. By defining a transparent, shared framework, AngelBlock seeks to improve protections and better align incentives throughout the fundraising journey.
